name: Brutal Hauberk
summary: Across the Barrens, Horde warriors face a trial before Thun'grim Firegaze will forge their mail. They gather rare materials and prove themselves against dangerous foes across the lands, then bring their bounty to the reclusive smith. He hammers it into armor built for battle.

sections.title: A Smith's Masterpiece
sections.body: In the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze forges armor only for warriors who meet his demands. The reclusive orc sends them far and wide to gather tough beast parts, rare metal, and alchemical reagents before he lights his bellows. The finished hauberk offers protection and marks the endurance and grit its wearer has shown, earning recognition from veteran fighters throughout the Horde.

sections.title: Forged in Hardship
sections.body: Thun'grim makes his demands punishing by design. Horde arms and armor are expected to carry the sweat and blood of their wearer from the moment they are made. When you hand over the finished Brutal Hauberk, the smith offers no praise. He expects you to prove the armor in brutal combat and return with stories of blood and honor.

faq.answer: The Brutal Hauberk is a sturdy chestpiece crafted by the orc blacksmith Thun'grim Firegaze. Horde warriors earn it by proving their combat prowess and gathering rare materials across several dangerous lands.

Thun'grim Firegaze is a reclusive veteran smith who lives atop a mountain spur in the northern Barrens, just east of the road between the Crossroads and Orgrimmar. He tests emerging warriors and forges them specialized armor when they prove their worth.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim require so much effort before crafting the armor?
faq.answer: Horde warrior tradition prizes hardship alongside martial skill. Thun'grim believes fine mail belongs to those who have shed their own blood and labored to gather the rare components needed to forge it.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead next?
faq.answer: After Thun'grim presents you with the finished hauberk, his work for you is complete. You can wear the armor into battle across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Is the Brutal Hauberk quest available to the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. The Brutal Hauberk is a Horde trial. Alliance warriors undergo a separate martial rite with the smiths of Ironforge and the surrounding dwarven territories to forge their own signature armor.

faq.q: Where in the Barrens can Thun'grim be found?
faq.answer: Thun'grim lives on a high ridge in the northern Barrens, just south of Thorn Hill and east of the Crossroads.

angles.text: As a young Horde warrior, you earn the Brutal Hauberk as you pass from raw recruit to hardened combatant outfitted in custom mail.
As a member of the Horde, you can see its virtues of martial self-reliance and strength reflected in a hauberk made from trophies won in Kalimdor's wilds.
As a blacksmith, you can learn from Thun'grim's traditional orcish craft, where martial spirit and resilience are hammered into steel.
